title: Spheres entering the water at Guadalupe Island

tellings.quote: uh Lou Alzando and I think Sean Cahill went down to Guadalupe Island because there have been reports of

plain: There were reports of spheres going into the sea at Guadalupe Island, off Mexico, and so Luis Elizondo, the former head of a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, went there with a former Navy man named Sean Cahill. A former Defense Department official and columnist named Marik von Rennenkampff tells Michels this, linking the trip to the National Geographic series Unidentified. If the reports are true, they would point to objects moving between air and water.
